changes.before: Assemble actual all-41 evidence with the adopted DIM module-root v2 suite.
changes.after: Assemble actual all-41 evidence with the installed package-command v1 suite.

def suite(reader):
    pins = {name: {'path': PREFIX + name, 'sha256': digest} for name, digest in PINS.items()}
    for item in pins.values():
        reader.bound(item)
    base = 'physical-dim-package-runtime-preparation/'
    manifest_ref = pins[base + 'suite/actual-render-01/manifest.json']
    manifest = read(reader.bound(manifest_ref))
    adoption = read(reader.bound(pins[base + 'root-adoption-receipt.json']))
    installation = read(reader.bound(pins[base + 'installation-01/receipt.json']))
    require(adoption['kind'] == 'root-exact-package-runtime-suite-adoption'
            and adoption['review'] == pins[base + 'ROOT-ADOPTION.md']
            and adoption['rendered_manifest'] == manifest_ref
            and adoption['reconstructed_python_helpers'] == 7
            and adoption['old_dependencies_retained'] is True, 'Wrong actual suite adoption')
    require(manifest['format'] == 'prospective-package-command-helper-suite-1'
            and installation['status'] == 'REVIEWED_NEW_HELPERS_INSTALLED_BYTE_EXACT_NO_OPERATIONAL_RUN'
            and installation['manifest'] == manifest_ref, 'Wrong actual helper installation')
    entries = manifest['entry_points']
    by_path = {item['path']: item for item in entries.values()}
    require(len(by_path) == len(entries) == 8
            and {PREFIX + name for name in HELPERS.values()} < set(by_path), 'Mixed helper suite')
    require(len(installation['installed']) == 8
            and {item['path']: item for item in installation['installed']} == by_path,
            'Installed helpers differ from reviewed render')
    helpers = {key: by_path[PREFIX + name] for key, name in HELPERS.items()}
    for item in by_path.values():
        reader.bound(item)
    dependency_ref = entries['dependencies']
    require(dependency_ref['path'] == PREFIX + 'gate-helpers/source-context-package-command-v1-validator-dependencies.json',
            'Mixed dependency manifest')
    dependencies = read(reader.bound(dependency_ref))
    require(dependencies['audit_validator'] == helpers['closed'], 'Dependency validator differs')
    for item in [*dependencies['validator_dependencies'], *dependencies['source_context_protocol_inputs']]:
        reader.bound(item)
    batch_pins = literal(reader.bound(helpers['batch']), 'PINNED')
    for filename, digest in batch_pins.items():
        reader.bound({'path': PREFIX + 'gate-helpers/' + filename, 'sha256': digest})
    require(batch_pins[Path(HELPERS['support']).name] == helpers['support']['sha256']
            and batch_pins[Path(HELPERS['rebind_validator']).name] == helpers['rebind_validator']['sha256']
            and batch_pins[Path(dependency_ref['path']).name] == dependency_ref['sha256'],
            'Batch selected helper pins differ')
    projection = reader.bound(helpers['global'])
    validator = literal(projection, 'FINAL_VALIDATOR_PIN')
    validator_dependencies = literal(projection, 'FINAL_VALIDATOR_DEPENDENCIES')
    require(validator == helpers['closed'], 'Global selected validator differs')
    actual = {(item['path'], item['sha256']) for item in validator_dependencies}
    require(len(actual) == len(validator_dependencies) == 11
            and {(item['path'], item['sha256']) for item in dependencies['validator_dependencies']} <= actual
            and (helpers['support']['path'], helpers['support']['sha256']) in actual,
            'Mixed global validator dependencies')
    for item in validator_dependencies:
        reader.bound(item)
    return {'helpers': helpers, 'pins': pins, 'dependencies': dependency_ref,
            'validator': validator, 'validator_dependencies': validator_dependencies,
            'runtime_pins': {'path': PREFIX + 'gate-helpers/batch-rebind-runtime-pins.json',
                             'sha256': batch_pins['batch-rebind-runtime-pins.json']}}
